author: CBR
description:
Johnny Yong Bosch breaks down why antiheroes in pop culture are so compelling: they’ve usually gone through something, they’re hiding part of themselves, and the most interesting moments happen when the mask starts to crack. 

This Heroes Journey Short explores antihero characters, emotional backstory, performance, and what makes darker heroes feel human.
